verdict.rationale: Speculative decoding is a fair performance axis for an on-device LLM inference SDK, but nothing in the evidence mentions it (no draft models, no lookahead or assisted decoding). The pack only covers adjacent acceleration: Hexagon NPU execution, silicon-validated kernels and MetalRT benchmarks. Those are different techniques and earn no credit for this story.
